mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a short-term decline in equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the preceding month
regime_hint: tightening cycle after a period of easing
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the mean of the 30-day pre-tightening window (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests labor market strengthening, which precedes a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases over the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite the labor signal persists for at least 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% from the prior month's level coincides with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return, reflecting stronger economic momentum.
failure_condition: No significant correlation between INDPRO momentum and SPX 20-day returns in 100 backtests.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for two consecutive months indicates deflationary pressure, which is associated with negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL remains below 2 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero in deflationary regimes.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS falls below 3%, it predicts a 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate future rate cuts.
failure_condition: 3-month FEDFUNDS trend reversal does not materialize or 20-day returns are flat.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates economic recovery.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE stays below 4.5% for 4 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both retail sales (not available) and industrial production (INDPRO) with no lag is required to produce a positive 20-day SPX forward return; missing one component nullifies the effect.
failure_condition: The signal is present but 20-day returns are negative when retail sales data is available and shows weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) above 3% for three consecutive months indicates cost-push inflation, which is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative in inflationary regimes.
